cells: Celltype in CD8 eff. 1 / CD8 eff. 2, combined for primary CR vs REL comparison
individual: orig; retain original patient_id and group in metadata
normalization: RNA counts divided by all-RNA cell library size times 10000
DE_unit: one mean normalized expression vector per orig; log1p transform; two-sided Welch t-test, 3 CR vs 3 REL individuals
log2FC: log2((mean of individual mean normalized counts in CR+1)/(same in REL+1))
heatmap_selection: P<0.05, abs(log2FC)>=0.25, detection>=10% in at least one outcome; exclude technical genes; top100 per direction by P, then abs log2FC; include all ten prespecified genes regardless of selection
heatmap: individual columns, gene rows; row z-scores of log1p patient means; complete-linkage Euclidean hierarchical clustering; marker labels on sides
sensitivity: same CR vs REL patient-level analysis within CD8 eff.2 alone
marker_policy: retain requested labels and report observed direction/P; do not force expected outcome direction
source_policy: source object is read only; all results use new names
